title: Kompass: know who needs you before the deadline does
note: All numbers are from the synthetic November 2026 run in the app. Every scene shows 'Synthetic demo data'.

scenes.headline:
160 clients.
Three goals each.
One deadline per goal.
scenes.vo: In Bern, one caseworker supports around a hundred and sixty refugees. Every one of them has three goals, and every goal has a deadline.

scenes.headline: 11 Excel exports. Zero overview.
scenes.vo: The city is only paid when a goal is reached in time: German at A1, a real job, a year without social assistance. But the answers are buried in eleven Excel exports, and nobody sees who is about to miss a deadline, until it is too late.

scenes.caption: Drop the exports. Same clicks every month.
scenes.vo: Drop this month's exports. Kompass recognises every table by its columns, spots a renamed one, asks once, and remembers it. Next month: the same clicks.

scenes.caption: 18 goals reached, never billed.
scenes.vo: Seconds later, the whole service at a glance. Every goal, every deadline, and eighteen goals that were reached but never billed. Money on the table, found automatically.

scenes.caption: Who do I call this week, and why?
scenes.vo: Each caseworker gets a call list for the week, ranked by urgency, never by money. Amina: her A1 deadline is in a hundred and twelve days. Why is she stuck? Her intake report says it: two small children, and no daycare place.

scenes.caption: Local AI reads the report. A person confirms.
scenes.vo: That insight comes from free-text reports, read by an AI model running on this laptop. Names are removed first, every field shows the sentence it came from, and a social worker confirms it.

scenes.caption: 78 vs 29 in 100. Groups, never a score per person.
scenes.vo: Across the caseload, Kompass shows what works. People who can read Latin script reach A1 almost three times as often. That is where literacy courses pay off. Always groups, never a score for a person.

scenes.caption: Just ask. The rules compute, the AI explains.
scenes.vo: And you can simply ask. Visualise goal two. The rules compute the numbers, the AI explains them, and it answers out loud.

scenes.caption: Excel in. Excel out. One computer, no cloud for client data.
scenes.vo: Everything goes back out as Excel, one file per caseworker. And it runs on one computer: client data never goes to the cloud, names are removed before the AI, and groups under ten stay hidden.

scenes.headline: Kompass
scenes.sub: Know who needs you, before the deadline does.
scenes.credits:
